1. Conventions and actors

Requirements use stable IDs: FR-<AREA>-<NNN>. Priority is P0 (launch blocker), P1 (launch-critical but degradable), P2 (post-launch) or P3 (optional). Each requirement is written so that it can become a test case. "Must" is mandatory; "should" is expected unless a documented exception exists.

ActorDescriptionCapabilities
GuestUnauthenticated visitor.Browse, search, view listings/stores/reviews, register, sign in.
BuyerAny authenticated user.Chat, negotiate, checkout, order, review, favourite, apply for Flex.
SellerA user with a seller profile.List, manage stock, answer, accept/decline, dispatch, view analytics, buy promotions.
Premium sellerSeller with an active subscription.Premium badge, contact buttons, banner, analytics, featured credits, priority ranking.
GuarantorPerson consenting to a Flex guarantee.View terms, consent/decline, withdraw; no marketplace account required.
AdminStaff with granular permissions.Moderate, verify, resolve, refund, reconcile, configure, audit.
Super adminStaff with all permissions.Everything, including role changes and staff management.
SystemWorker/scheduler.Expiry, release, reminders, outbox, feeds, CAPI, purge.

Priority definitions

PriorityMeaning
P0Cannot launch without it; security, money or core journey.
P1Launch-critical; may launch in a limited mode with a documented workaround.
P2Post-launch enhancement.
P3Optional / scale.

2. Authentication and accounts (FR-AUTH)

IDRequirementPriorityAcceptance criteria
FR-AUTH-001Register with email, phone, name and password.P0Valid input creates account; duplicate email/phone rejected; password policy enforced; response does not leak existence.
FR-AUTH-002Verify phone with a 6-digit OTP.P0OTP expires in 10 min; 5 attempts; resend limits 3/10 min and 10/day; success marks phone verified.
FR-AUTH-003Sign in with email + password.P0Correct credentials return access + refresh; wrong password increments lockout; 5 failures lock 15 min.
FR-AUTH-004Captcha challenge for new devices or after failures.P0Required when no valid device marker within 24 h or after 3 wrong passwords; verified server-side before password check.
FR-AUTH-005Rotating refresh tokens with reuse detection.P0Refresh rotates; reuse revokes the family; cookie httpOnly/SameSite=Lax/Secure in prod; CSRF header required.
FR-AUTH-006Password reset without account enumeration.P0Same response for known/unknown email; token single-use and expiring; reset revokes sessions.
FR-AUTH-007TOTP 2FA with recovery codes.P1Setup returns secret + QR; enable requires a valid code; recovery codes single-use; replay rejected; disable requires password/code.
FR-AUTH-008Google sign-in.P2OIDC flow; no staff accounts; 2FA still required; button hidden when not configured.
FR-AUTH-009Session revocation.P0Password change, role change, account disable or logout invalidates access via token version and refresh family.
FR-AUTH-010Admin 2FA enforcement.P0With ADMIN_2FA_REQUIRED=true, staff without 2FA cannot use admin APIs; boot fails if off in production.

3. Sellers and verification (FR-SEL)

IDRequirementPriorityAcceptance criteria
FR-SEL-001Become a seller.P0One seller profile per user; store name, slug, state, city, contact; duplicate slug handled.
FR-SEL-002Storefront and branding.P1Public store page with logo, banner, about, listings, reviews and verification badge.
FR-SEL-003Verification tiers.P0Phone → identity → business; documents stored privately; admin decision; tier visible on listings.
FR-SEL-004BVN lookup and name match.P1Encrypted BVN; keyed fingerprint prevents reuse; lenient name match; failure reason recorded.
FR-SEL-005Seller analytics.P1Views, favourites, enquiries, orders, earnings, conversion; premium-only depth gated server-side.
FR-SEL-006Seller suspension.P0Admin can suspend; listings hidden; sessions revoked; audit entry written.
FR-SEL-007Premium contact controls.P1WhatsApp/phone buttons only for active premium; server-enforced; client flags ignored.

4. Catalog and listings (FR-CAT, FR-LST)

IDRequirementPriorityAcceptance criteria
FR-CAT-001Category tree.P017 roots, 91 categories; two levels; slug unique; active/inactive; admin reorder.
FR-CAT-002Locations.P036 states + FCT; cities per state; listing state must be valid.
FR-LST-001Create a listing.P0Title, category, condition, price, stock, description, location, delivery options; validation errors are specific.
FR-LST-002Image upload and ordering.P0Up to per-seller cap; re-encode to WebP; watermark; reorder; delete; first image is cover.
FR-LST-003Auto-title suggestions.P2Deterministic suggestions from brand/model/condition/category; detects year, storage, colour, size; does not invent facts.
FR-LST-004Listing lifecycle.P0Draft/active/paused/sold/removed; soft delete; purge after 30 days; views and favourites counted.
FR-LST-005Stock and availability.P0Quantity decremented atomically at checkout; restored on expiry/refund; zero-stock blocks checkout.
FR-LST-006Delivery options.P0Pickup, courier, seller delivery; fee and ETA; buyer selects at checkout; server validates the choice.
FR-LST-007Moderation.P0Admin approve/reject with reason; rejected listings hidden; seller notified; audit.
FR-LST-008Promotion badges.P1TOP and Premium badges reflect active promotions only; cleared automatically on expiry.

5. Search and discovery (FR-SRC)

IDRequirementPriorityAcceptance criteria
FR-SRC-001Keyword search.P0Prefix matching (e.g. "iph" → iPhone); weighted title/brand/description; empty query returns a browse feed.
FR-SRC-002Filters and sorting.P0State, category, price range, condition, brand, BNPL, delivery; sort by relevance, newest, price.
FR-SRC-003Facets.P1Counts for the current result set; selecting a facet updates results without losing context.
FR-SRC-004Ranking.P1Featured → premium → text rank → recency; no paid placement that fails quality gates.
FR-SRC-005Favourites and saved items.P1Toggle favourite; count on listing; buyer-only list; idempotent.
FR-SRC-006Recommendations.P2"For you" from interest signals; excludes inactive/blocked listings; bounded signal storage.
FR-SRC-007Cache safety.P1Anonymous search cache TTL 15 s; no user-specific data in shared cache; invalidation on listing changes.

6. Messaging and negotiation (FR-MSG, FR-NEG)

IDRequirementPriorityAcceptance criteria
FR-MSG-001Start a product-linked chat.P0Buyer and seller only; one thread per context; non-participants get 404; rate limited.
FR-MSG-002Send and read messages.P0Text sanitised; pagination; read receipts; unread counts; polling every 5 s while visible.
FR-MSG-003Report a message.P0Report created; admin queue; reporter confirmation; no retaliation exposure.
FR-MSG-004Direct-contact warning.P0Buyer sees a warning before off-platform contact; acknowledgement recorded; premium contact still gated.
FR-NEG-001Make an offer.P0Offer ≥ 10% of list price; one live negotiation per buyer/product; 48 h expiry; seller notified.
FR-NEG-002Counter-offer.P0Turn-taking enforced; counter direction enforced; 10-round cap; stale offer ID returns 409.
FR-NEG-003Accept and checkout.P0Accepted offer locks the price for that buyer for 24 h; checkout uses the agreed price; listing price unchanged.
FR-NEG-004Expiry and withdrawal.P0Expired offers cannot be accepted; withdrawal notifies the other party; expired negotiation frees the slot.

7. Payments and protected checkout (FR-PAY, FR-CHK)

IDRequirementPriorityAcceptance criteria
FR-PAY-001Provider abstraction.P0Mock, Paystack and Flutterwave implement initialize/verify/refund/webhook; active provider selected by env.
FR-PAY-002Server-side verification.P0Success requires exact amount and currency from the provider; underpayment never funds an order.
FR-PAY-003Webhook security.P0Signature verified; invalid → 403; events de-duplicated by (provider, event_key); webhook only triggers verification.
FR-PAY-004Idempotent checkout.P0Same Idempotency-Key returns the same payment/order; duplicate clicks do not double-charge.
FR-PAY-005Refunds.P0Full or amount-based refund via provider; one active refund per order; status reconciled.
FR-CHK-001Checkout quote.P0Subtotal + delivery + protection fee = total; server-computed; protection capped; DB constraint enforces the sum.
FR-CHK-002Create order and reserve stock.P0Atomic stock decrement; failure returns a clear out-of-stock error; unpaid order expires in 60 min.
FR-CHK-003Escrow hold.P0On verified payment, partner creates a hold; funds are not released until the order state allows it.
FR-CHK-004Late payment.P0After expiry, re-check provider; honour if stock remains, otherwise auto-refund.
FR-CHK-005Reconciliation.P0Admin report cross-checks payments, escrow and ledger; mismatches are surfaced, not silently corrected.

8. Orders, delivery, disputes and refunds (FR-ORD, FR-DSP)

IDRequirementPriorityAcceptance criteria
FR-ORD-001Seller accepts or declines.P0Only the seller can act; decline triggers refund; accept moves to processing.
FR-ORD-002Dispatch and tracking.P0Carrier, tracking number/URL and updates recorded; buyer notified; status order enforced.
FR-ORD-003Delivery evidence.P0Photos/notes attached; visible to buyer/admin; audit trail.
FR-ORD-004Buyer confirmation and auto-release.P0Buyer confirms → completed; otherwise auto-release after 3 days; no release while disputed.
FR-ORD-005Cancellation.P0Pre-dispatch cancellation refunds automatically; post-dispatch requires a dispute.
FR-DSP-001Open a dispute.P0Buyer opens within the allowed window; reason + evidence; seller notified; order frozen.
FR-DSP-002Dispute conversation.P0Buyer/seller/admin messages; evidence; timeline; no participant can delete history.
FR-DSP-003Resolution.P0Admin resolves with release or refund; refund needs a second, different admin; audit entry.
FR-DSP-004Partial refunds.P2Model supports amounts; UI and flow to be added post-launch.

9. Goods Flex (FR-FLX)

IDRequirementPriorityAcceptance criteria
FR-FLX-001Credit profile.P1Verified phone, BVN, connected bank, consented guarantor, optional employment; missing any required step leaves the limit at zero.
FR-FLX-002Affordability assessment.P1Six months classified; income detected; repayments deducted; risk factor applied; snapshot stored immutably with expiry.
FR-FLX-003Guarantor consent.P1SMS link; borrower, relationship, amount, expiry shown; explicit consent; IP/time/BVN ref recorded; decline/withdraw supported; max 3 active.
FR-FLX-004Apply and accept.P1Partner decision stored; terms shown verbatim; explicit acceptance; unpaid offer expires in 24 h.
FR-FLX-005One running plan.P1Approved/accepted/active/defaulted blocks a new plan; enforced under lock and by partial unique index.
FR-FLX-006Down payment and disbursement.P1Down payment via payment layer; partner disburses; order funded through escrow; refund cancels the agreement.
FR-FLX-007Instalments.P1Schedule shown; pay via payment layer; duplicate/excess payments auto-refunded; one open payment per instalment.
FR-FLX-008Overdue handling.P1Worker marks overdue and reminds; defaulted plans can still be paid off; no double reminders.

14. State machines

14.1 Order / escrow

pending_payment → payment_confirmed → funds_safeguarded → awaiting_seller → processing → dispatched → delivered → awaiting_buyer_confirmation → completed │ │ │ │ │ │ ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ cancelled refund_pending ←────────┴─────────────────┴──────────────┘ disputed → refunded / completed

Only modules/orders/escrow.py changes these statuses. Release/refund are guarded by row locks, a unique ledger key and the state machine.

14.2 Payment

StateMeaningAllowed next
initializedProvider checkout created; not trusted.pending, failed, expired
pendingAwaiting provider confirmation.paid, failed, expired
paidServer-to-server verified with exact amount/currency.refunded
failed / expiredNo funds captured; order may expire.—
refundedRefund confirmed by provider.—

14.3 Negotiation

StateMeaningAllowed next
openOffer/counter pending; turn owner defined.accepted, declined, expired, withdrawn, converted
acceptedPrice agreed; 24 h checkout window.converted, expired
convertedOrder paid at the agreed price.—
declined / withdrawn / expiredNo live offer; slot freed.—

14.4 Goods Flex plan

StateMeaningAllowed next
approvedLender approved; terms offered.accepted, expired, withdrawn
acceptedBuyer accepted; awaiting down payment/disbursement.active, cancelled
activeDisbursed; instalments due.completed, defaulted, cancelled
defaultedMissed instalments; still repayable.completed, cancelled
completed / cancelledPlan closed; slot freed.—

17. Acceptance scenarios

#ScenarioExpected result
AT-01New user registers, verifies phone, signs in.Account created; OTP verified; session issued; no sensitive data in response.
AT-02Seller creates a listing with 3 photos and a 60+ char description.Listing active; images watermarked and re-encoded; searchable; promotion eligibility true.
AT-03Buyer makes an offer, seller counters, buyer accepts.Turn-taking enforced; accepted price locked for 24 h; listing price unchanged.
AT-04Buyer pays through the provider (sandbox).Payment verified server-to-server; escrow hold created; stock decremented; seller notified.
AT-05Duplicate webhook arrives five times.Exactly one payment confirmation and one settlement; no double credit.
AT-06Wrong amount is sent.Payment rejected/underpayment not funded; order remains unpaid/cancelled.
AT-07Seller dispatches with evidence; buyer confirms.Order completed; ledger release posts commission and protection fee; seller payable recorded.
AT-08Buyer disputes before release.Order frozen; no auto-release; admin resolves; refund requires a second admin.
AT-09Flex customer connects bank, names guarantor, guarantor consents, applies.Limit computed; one plan; down payment; disbursement; instalments scheduled.
AT-10Second Flex application while a plan is running.Rejected with a clear error; partial unique index prevents a race.
AT-11Seller buys TOP 7 and Boost Premium.Server-priced; payment verified; badges and placement active; expiry clears them.
AT-12Admin without permission calls an admin endpoint.403; permission refusal audited; no state change.
AT-13Production boot with mock escrow/BNPL or dev secrets.Process refuses to start with a clear configuration error.
AT-14Anonymous search is cached; a listing changes.Cache TTL bounded; stale result is acceptable for ≤ 15 s; no user data leaks.
AT-15Marketing consent is declined.No pixel/GA scripts load; transactional email/SMS still works; consent can be changed.
Definition of done for a requirement
Code + tests (unit/integration/E2E where relevant) + migration if data changes + admin/ops visibility + documentation update. P0 requirements also need a staging verification against the real provider sandbox where an integration is involved.
